All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
including publications (with photocopy of certificate) for verification along with the duly filled
form giving the details at the time of interview on 15th September 2025 at 11 a.m.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(http://jobs.puchd.ac.in.forms.php pages 1 to 9).
Candidates are required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications in
original. Candidates are required to report at 10:00 a.m on the date of interview.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance
from any agency till they are teaching in the Department of Laws, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty.
